name: Ana Example
headline: Data Analyst | SQL, Python, Power BI | weekly reporting from 6 hours to 20 minutes
about:
I build the reporting layer retail teams actually use.

Most teams know their numbers are late and do not know which query made them late. I map the chain from the source system to the slide, find the step that costs hours, and replace it with one scheduled pipeline.

My stack: SQL, Python, Power BI, Excel when the client lives in Excel.

What I want next: a data team where the reporting is boring because it runs itself.

all: Rebuilt the weekly operations report as a scheduled query and a single dashboard.
